selected_gaps.gap: 在 semanticscholar:5f36a7aa0f042be743e19ad70fbdb1f3bf9ef97c 的 frontier residue 上，proposal-conditioned future 能说明整体提案可能失败，却没有闭合“失败由单个效应器动作不足、通道间冲突，还是只有联合改变才可修复”的决策歧义 — stakes: 纠错器可能反复修改无关动作维度、降低成功率并增加闭环计算，理论上也缺少把世界模型诊断量连接到动作更新责任边界的原则。
selected_gaps.companion_rationale: generative_process_redesign replaces the conventionally fixed, monolithic proposal-conditioned future with a common-carrier counterfactual transition bundle O whose four branches are re-anchored at the same nominal latent state at every horizon step; targeted_self_supervised_objective operates on O to learn a time-resolved interaction token that vanishes for additive effector transitions and directly conditions a paired action-refinement path.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: 这是瓶颈中最直接要求可运行 method 的缺口：纠错器必须把效应器交互变成动作生成的输入，同时避免把递归滚动产生的状态路径漂移误当成真实交互。generative_process_redesign 改写 ω-EVA 式整体未来反馈的固定条件粒度，以同一 carrier state 上的四个一步转移构造可比 bundle；targeted_self_supervised_objective 再把真正的非加性转移缺陷压成只进入跨效应器 refinement branch 的 token，因此交互不会被折叠为中心梯度，也不是用 WAM 充当标量 Q 的经典响应面优化。

deliverable_coverage: method — anchor generative_process_redesign constructs the runnable common-carrier counterfactual refinement pathway, and companion targeted_self_supervised_objective makes its interaction token identifiable and action-changing

deferred_gaps.gap: 在 arxiv:2608.04653 的 frontier residue 上，整体 action controllability 相同的两个模型仍可能具有完全不同的效应器级因果结构：一个主要依赖单臂边际，另一个只在双臂联合变化时响应；Phase 0 没有给出能区分这两类失败、且在连续动作通道与时序滚动中仍有定义的量 — stakes: 研究者会把整体响应提升误判为可控协作，部署时会对错误的手臂或通道进行纠正，知识层面则无法判断 action-sensitive world model 是否真正学会了协调动力学。
deferred_gaps.reason: fails removal test — the anchor's common-carrier transition bundle already supplies an effector-resolved, time-indexed interaction quantity and its action-changing path; a separate model-level controllability score would make the paper larger but not make the correction claim runnable

deferred_gaps.reason: fails removal test — state-local interaction tokens do not assume fixed roles, so a separate role-reversal audit is useful evaluation but not required to define or execute the anchor mechanism
